item.title: Bsd Sockets p1 - Basic TCP server
item.description: I want to preface this by saying that if you are interested in learning about Berkley Sockets, I highly recomend you buy ‘Beej’s Guide to Network Programming’. It is where I got most of my knoweledge from and I highly recomend it. In this post I am going to introduce Berkley sockets and show how I wrote a simple tcp server in C.
